Supporting animal rescue organizations and their volunteers by improving the coordination and communications required during animal rescue. Doobert.com is web-based software designed to simplify the animal rescue process, allowing rescues to focus time and resources on saving more of the estimated 3-4 million companion animals that are euthanized each year. 

Designed by animal rescuers, Doobert.com connects animal welfare and rescue organizations with ground and aviation transporters nationwide. It simplifies the scheduling and management of animal transports, and streamlines fundraising and sponsorship efforts.
